title: Use Azure Text To Speech
desc: Note: Requires an Azure account with TTS enabled, and key saved in AzureCache folder. IMPORTANT REMINDER: You are responsible for usage charges on your Cloud voice account. EDCoPilot will warn you when monthly free quota thresholds are met, and you can disable this feature if you are going to exceed your free quota, or continue usage and be billed accordingly.

title: Azure Region
desc: Step 1: (Requires EDCoPilot restart to take effect if changing region) Select the region that will be called (may impact latency). This will load the table of Locale, Gender and Name available in that Region

title: Azure Language
desc: Step 2: Select the language you require (note:  to use non-English languages, enroll and enable Google Translate services with Google, then enable Google Translate in the Google Text To Speech section above

title: Azure Locale
desc: Step 3: Select the locale (accent) from which you will pick voices.

title: Azure Voice Gender
desc: Step 4: Select the gender of voice required, to re-load the list of available voices

title: Azure Voice Name
desc: Step 5: Select the Azure voice to be used

title: Azure Voice Rate
desc: Change the speed of your copilot voice, as a percentage relative to its default rate (range: 50 to 200)

title: Azure Pitch
desc: Change the pitch of your copilot voice (range -2.0 to +2.0 semitones)

title: Reset Azure character counts (CAUTION)
desc: ** WARNING ** Resets your counters of characters sent to Azure. ONLY click this if you wish to set counters to 0 to reset usage count for next billing cycle
